item.title: Rob Pardo Announced As GDC Festival of Gaming Keynote Speaker
item.description: GDC Festival of Gaming has announced that Bonfire Studios co-Founder Rob Pardo will be the keynote speaker for this year's event

item.title: The House of Hikmah Confirmed For Early April Launch
item.description: After having run a free demo during Steam Next Fest last month, The House of Hikmah has been confirmed for release in early April

item.title: Atomic Heart Announces Fourth DLC: Blood on Crystal
item.description: Atomic Heart has confirmed the next DLC is on the way, as Blood on Crystal will arrive this April with the game's Ultimate Edition

item.title: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands Confirmed For Meta Quest Launch
item.description: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands has been given a launch date for Meta Quest this month, as the game will also arrive on Steam later

item.title: TAST!EZ Launches New Game Night Loungewear Set
item.description: TAST!EZ has launched a new line of loungewear to match their snacks for those who love to snack while they play games at home

item.title: Ocean's Prequel: Lee Isaac Chung Will Not Longer Direct
item.description: Director Lee Isaac Chung has reportedly left the Ocean's Prequel film, citing "creative differences," though Margot Robbie is still attached to star.

item.title: Fabula Rasa: Dead Man Talking To Premier at SXSW 2026
item.description: The game Fabula Rasa: Dead Man Talking will be making its debut at SXSW 2026, giving attendees a chance to try a demo of the title

item.title: Hotel Barcelona Releases Under New Management Update
item.description: Hotel Barcelonahas been given a bit of a facelift and an upgrade as the developers have released the Under New Management update
